title: Quenched Dense Thai Steak Curry
description: A roasted, dense, light Thai (Northern) dish featuring lean minced steak and crispy lardons in a low-carb curry.
instructions: Heat a wok over medium-high heat and add the coconut oil.
Add the lardons and cook until they release fat and brown, then remove with a slotted spoon.
In the same wok, sauté the onion until translucent, then stir in the ginger and chili.
Push the aromatics to the side and add the minced steak, cooking until sealed.
Stir in the Thai red curry paste, spreading it evenly over the meat mixture.
Pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime juice, then bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to medium and let the curry thicken, stirring occasionally, for about 12 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of sugar if needed, then return the browned lardons to the wok.
Cook for an additional 3 minutes until everything is heated through and flavors meld.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro, directly from the wok.
